Identity presentation & website direction

Rachelé Nails

Warmth, with a signature.

The starting point

Warmth, with a signature.

The original identity pairs a bronze RN monogram with warm peach, fine botanical details and the name Rachelé Nails. The acute accent belongs on the final é. The website direction carries that character into a setting where visitors can explore real sets and understand the services.

The work covered

  • Original identity presentation
  • Colour and type application
  • Service presentation
  • Website art direction

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

Peach and deep bronze connect the website to the original artwork. Expressive serif headings sit beside straightforward service descriptions, while close-up nail imagery supplies the detail. The brand presentation and the work each have a clear role: establish the mood, then show what the nail artist does.

  • #F1DFD1

The words

Beautiful nails, one set at a time.

The existing line is personal and easy to understand. It keeps the focus on the work and the care behind each set, with Gel-X, acrylic extensions and nail art described plainly alongside it.
